charters.shortDescription: The British Virgin Islands has always been and continues to be recognized as a world leader of great places to go sailing. Since it became a major charter sailing destination in the early 70s, you'd think that other cool new locations would have taken its place by now. Not so. The answer lies in its privileged geography and friendly people.
Every charter at FlyAway Charters is private and customized. We pride ourselves on providing a unique experience bolstered by our extensive local knowledge to provide the perfect experience for you.
